To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Edward Lin court documents with a minimum of redacted versions:
Stipulation of Fact PACOM Review
Stipulation of Fact JSOC Review
Stipulation of Fact Navflt Review
Stipulation of Fact AFRICOM Review

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

False_Yobioctet

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

- Presidential records of the 45th Presidential Administration, between January 20, 2017 and January 20, 2021, from the Office of the Senior Advisor, the Office of the President, the Office of the Chief of Staff, the Office of the Staff Secretary, and the National Security Council, consisting of calendars, schedules, visitor records, meeting minutes, memoranda, emails, correspondence, and records of messaging applications concerning meetings or communications between Jared Kushner and Mohamed bin Zayed, Mohammed bin Salman, Tahnoon bin Zayed, Dherar Belhoul Al Falasi, Benjamin Netanyahu, or David M. Friedman, including the following words/phrases "Kushner," "Mohamed bin Zayed," "MBZ," "Mohammed bin Salman," "MBS," "Tahnoon," "Al Falasi," "Netanyahu," "Friedman"

- Presidential records of the 45th Presidential Administration, between January 20, 2017 and January 20, 2021, from the Office of the Senior Advisor, the Office of the President, the Office of the Chief of Staff, the Office of the Staff Secretary, and the National Security Council, referencing bank accounts, transfers, deposits, or wires involving Jared Kushner, including the following words/phrases "First Abu Dhabi Bank," "FAB," "Watani Al Emarat," "Central Bank of Israel," "Bank of Israel," "Azerbaijan," "signatory," "slush fund"

If any part of these documents are exempt from disclosure, please be sure to review and release all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive documents, as the FOIA requires.

I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

All documents protected between October 22, from September 1, of any document produced by the City of Berkeley that pertain to any modification of a fire setback

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbie Powelson

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Kushner
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Records of any kind, between January 1, 2017 and the present, from the Office of Foreign Assets Control, concerning the Watani Al Emarat Foundation, including any sanctions designation, review, reconsideration, or delisting files, referral memoranda, administrative records, and correspondence, including the following words/phrases "Watani Al Emarat," "Watani"

Records of any kind, between January 1, 2017 and the present, from the Office of Foreign Assets Control, concerning Dherar Belhoul Al Falasi and Tahnoon bin Zayed, including any designation, review, or delisting files, referral memoranda, administrative records, and correspondence, including the following words/phrases "Dherar Belhoul Al Falasi," "Tahnoon bin Zayed," "Tahnoon"

Records of any kind, between January 1, 2017 and the present, from the Office of Foreign Assets Control, concerning First Abu Dhabi Bank, including any sanctions review, enforcement, administrative action, or assessment records, and any records concerning the bank's United States correspondent accounts or its transactions through the U.S. financial system, including the following words/phrases "First Abu Dhabi Bank," "FAB," "National Bank of Abu Dhabi"

Records of any kind, between January 1, 2017 and the present, from the Office of Foreign Assets Control, referencing Jared Kushner together with any of the following words/phrases "First Abu Dhabi Bank," "Watani Al Emarat," "Azerbaijan," "Central Bank of Israel," "Bank of Israel," "United Arab Emirates," "Saudi Arabia"

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
